items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Avery and Aaron Scott seemed to be your rhythm section for a while... Aaron replaced him [Louis Hayes].

ctx.x: Aaron was living in Paris wasn’t he?
I don’t know. Louis was because we went to Brazil and Sonny Rollins, all of us went with Louis, but Avery yes, they were very--
